messages:
maria (product): Rolling out tiny-edge A500X pools to SCL (Santiago) and YVR (Vancouver) today. This is an edge-optimized SKU for low-latency regional inference.
sam (eng-platform): Quick facts: A500X is power/thermals optimized, 16GB device, single-socket nodes. We packed 12 devices in SCL (12x1) and 10 in YVR (10x1).
owen (edge-ops): Ops notes: edge pools are preemptible by design during the preview. Preemption window = 5m warning + graceful drain. We'll surface warning to clients via websocket event preempt.notice.
claire (sales): Which customers are eligible for preview? Need to message channel partners.
maria (product): Pilot customers only. Focus on retail edge, ingest-heavy inference, and mobile sync use-cases. We'll enable via enrollment form and tag their workspaces with "edge-a500x-preview".
sam (eng-platform): Deployment status: deploy-bot reports rta-edge-a500x-scl v0.1 -> success (216555999A) ; (note: internal id includes letters for this infra throwaway)
deploy-bot: deploy completed: rta-edge-a500x-yvr v0.1 -> success (2165559991)
claire (sales): Pricing question — do we treat it like a Dedicated SKU or a burstable edge offering?
billing-bot: provisional SKU: dedicated.a500x.edge.<region>.minute-unit. Edge premium applies: +12% on per-minute billing during preview. Finance approved provisional rates.
owen (edge-ops): Policy change for edge pools during preview: 1) max session length per connection = 30m. 2) no autoscale-to-zero: baseline 1 node kept warm per pool. 3) preemptions are billed for first 30s of shutdown window as normal.
sam (eng-platform): Routing/fallback: if edge pool loses capacity, route to nearest regional standard pool (e.g., us-west/h100 or eu-central/h200) with explicit QoS tag "edge-fallback" and a 20% latency SLO relaxation. Configured in routing policy edge-routing-v2.
maria (product): Important: make sure clients know model footprint limits. A500X only supports single-GPU model shards up to 9.5GB resident. Multi-GPU shards will be rejected; we'll return a structured error code ERR_MODEL_TOO_LARGE.
claire (sales): Copy. I'll update pilot onboarding docs and send an opt-in note to partner integrators.
sam (eng-platform): Telemetry: new metrics emitted: a500x.p99_latency_ms, a500x.memory_pressure_pct, a500x.preemptions.count. Please wire to Console.
owen (edge-ops): Runbook snippet: if preemptions spike > 5% over 10m, escalate to @sam and @maria. Check /var/log/redwood/edge-preempt.log and capture last 3 preemption traces. Ticket EDGE-1022 created.
maria (product): Marketing: hold external announcement until 48h steady-state and zero data-plane incidents. Internal heads-up to partners allowed with "preview" language.
claire (sales): Understood. Will coordinate partner comms to emphasize "preview" and session limits.
sam (eng-platform): DEV repro tip if someone sees mismatched drivers in edge images: run `kubectl -n edge get pods -o wide | grep a500x` then `kubectl exec -it <pod> -- cat /sys/module/nvidia/version`. Share output in thread.
owen (edge-ops): Known issue: small regression with GRPC connection resets when models use KV-cache + int8 in long-run (observed at ~22m). Workaround: restart model worker with env REDWOOD_KV_WARMUP=1. Ticket EDGE-1023.
maria (product): TL;DR: A500X edge pools now live in SCL/YVR for pilot customers only. Preemptible, session-limited, provisional pricing. Tag workspaces with "edge-a500x-preview" to join. Report regressions to #eng-platform and label incidents EDGE-1022/EDGE-1023. Next update in 12h or on any high-severity incident. :satellite:
